items.title: What's New in Iru | October 23rd
items.text: Highlights this week in What’s New in Iru:

items.title: Iru Agent for Mac Release 5.2.7 (5401)
items.text:
We’ve released Iru Agent for Mac 5.2.7 (5401).
This release adds Korean localization to Passport, Self Service, Liftoff, and the Iru menu bar app.

items.title: Mac Custom Apps: Now with support for 30 GB installers
items.text: Mac Custom App Library Items now support installers up to 30 GB in size. Downloads happen in the background in the Iru Agent as to not hold up processing of other Library Items, and downloads auto resume when possible if they are interrupted by network hiccups or devices sleeping.

items.title: Iru Agent for Windows Release 1.24.6.0
items.text: We've released Iru Agent for Windows 1.24.6.0. This release fixes apps missing from device inventory, stops apps reinstalling repeatedly when an installer leaves an older entry in Add/Remove Programs, and stops the Self Service updater creating a system restore point that some endpoint security tools flagged.

items.title: What's New in Iru | October 16th
items.text: Highlights we cover this week in What's New in Iru:

items.title: Iru AI assistant for BitLocker and Android Restrictions
items.text: Iru AI now builds Library Items for BitLocker on Windows and Android Restrictions from a plain-language description. Describe the disk encryption policy or device restrictions you need, and Iru AI sets up the Library Item for you.

items.title: Target OS version for Automated Device Enrollment
items.text: Automated Device Enrollment now has an update to setting in addition to the minimum required OS version, so you can set a floor for enrollment and a separate version that devices update to. Devices below the minimum update to that version before they enroll, and devices already at or above the minimum enroll without updating. This works for macOS, iOS, and iPadOS, and existing configurations keep their current behavior.

items.title: Automatically rotate FileVault recovery keys after viewing
items.text: FileVault recovery keys can now rotate automatically after an administrator views the current key. Turn on Automatically rotate keys after viewing in the FileVault Library Item and set when the rotation happens. Key views continue to be recorded in the device activity timeline.

items.title: Platform SSO OpenID and web login settings for macOS 27
items.text: The Single Sign-On Library Item now supports OpenID sign-in on macOS 27 and later, so users can sign in through identity provider web sign-in pages, including multi-factor authentication, at the login window, Lock Screen, and FileVault unlock. New settings let you sync the web login password to the local account and set a web login URL allow list. These settings apply only to Macs running macOS 27 or later, and OpenID depends on the identity provider supporting it.

items.title: Upgrade your Android Enterprise integration to a managed Google domain
items.text: Admins can now upgrade an Android Enterprise integration from a managed Google Play account to their organization's managed Google domain, directly from the Iru web app and without re-enrolling any devices.

items.title: Recommended privacy permissions for Mac
items.text:
The Privacy Library Item's Recommended privacy permissions area now supports Mac, in addition to iPhone and iPad. Admins can recommend app permissions for macOS apps and website permissions for Safari, so end users see a single consent prompt listing everything an app or site needs instead of being prompted one permission at a time. The user can select Allow to grant every recommended permission at once, or Not Now, in which case the app continues to prompt for individual permissions as it normally would.
Supported Mac app permissions include Bluetooth, Camera, Dictation, Local Network, Location, and Microphone. Mac apps are identified by bundle ID and code requirement, and a recommendation applies only when the installed app's code signature matches. Website rules use the same specific and wildcard domains as iPhone and iPad. This requires Macs on macOS 27 or later.
For more details, see Configure the Privacy Library Item.

items.title: Iru Agent for Windows Release 1.23.7
items.text: We've released Iru Agent for Windows 1.23.7. This release includes miscellaneous bug fixes and performance improvements.

items.title: Iru now supports Windows 11 26H2
items.text:
Windows 11 26H2 is here, and Iru is ready for it. Devices running 26H2 can now be enrolled in Iru, so your team can onboard new hardware and upgraded fleets without waiting or building workarounds.
We've also added a new Managed OS Library Item for Windows 11 26H2, which lets IT teams set 26H2 as the target version and keep devices on a consistent, supported release from one place. For customers, that means a smoother path to the latest Windows release with the same control and visibility they already have in Iru.

items.title: New and More Detailed Identity Activity Log
items.text: The Iru Identity activity log now shows a new, more detailed view of activities, including user sign-ins, application management, account lifecycle events, and group management. You can filter the table by activity time, activity type, outcome, user, actor, and application. Multiple filter conditions at once are also supported.

items.title: Managed OS for Apple: Dynamic timeline view
items.text: Managed OS for Apple devices now includes a dynamic timeline view that adjusts to the settings defined in the Library Item, taking the guesswork out of when a particular update will be enforced and to which version a device will be forced to update.
